output.title: Cloudflare DNS01 fix applicability unclear: no issuer config visible
output.content: The fix addresses DNS01 certificate issuance on Cloudflare. The environment has cert-manager installed with the Certificate CRD and apiVersion cert-manager.io/v1, but the environment summary does not expose Issuer or ClusterIssuer resources, DNS provider configurations, or Cloudflare API credentials. To determine applicability, inspect your Issuer/ClusterIssuer definitions for Cloudflare DNS01 provider configuration and any related dnsChallenges settings.
